summary: Sabrina explains Earth's rotation and revolution and how they contribute to night, day, and seasons. Aligned with 5th-grade NGSS standards but accessible for Grade 3 learners.

subject: Science
summary: Explore America's National Parks and discover how wild animal parents protect and teach their babies critical life skills during their dangerous first year.

summary: Learn to draw Earth and Moon as cute buddies. A creative art lesson that connects to science learning about our planet and its natural satellite.

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn to find the perimeter of polygons by adding the lengths of all sides. Understand that perimeter is the distance around a shape.

title: The Elapsed Time Song | How Much Time Has Passed?

summary: Learn to measure mass in grams and kilograms and volume in liters. Compare and estimate the mass and volume of everyday objects.

summary: Learn to represent fractions on a number line. Understand that fractions are numbers that live between whole numbers on the number line.

summary: Learn that equivalent fractions represent the same amount even though they look different. 1/2 = 2/4 = 3/6 - same size, different names.

title: The Quadrilaterals Song | Squares, Rectangles, Rhombuses, Trapezoids
subject: Mathematics
summary: Learn about different types of quadrilaterals - squares, rectangles, rhombuses, parallelograms, and trapezoids. Understand their defining attributes.

title: The Subject and Predicate Song | Complete Sentences
subject: English
summary: Learn that every complete sentence has a subject (who or what the sentence is about) and a predicate (what the subject is doing). Identify subjects and predicates in sentences.

title: The Types of Sentences Song | Declarative, Interrogative, Imperative, Exclamatory
subject: English
summary: Learn the four types of sentences - declarative (statement), interrogative (question), imperative (command), and exclamatory (excitement). Identify and write each type.

title: The Context Clues Song | Finding Word Meanings

summary: Learn to use context clues to figure out the meaning of unknown words. Look for definitions, examples, synonyms, antonyms, and general context in the text.
